news.detail: Gray started alongside Travis Kelce, playing 50 percent of the Chiefs' offensive snaps in the overtime contest. Gray assisted in blocking for Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker and was also a meaningful part of the special-teams unit, although he failed to corral his only target.

profile: role: TE2 rotational — 3% of targets, 52% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
